about: The outputs of the KDA tests that miss both the naive BF16 tier and FLA 0.6.0 and that the owner accepted, each only for its own test and output and only up to its caps. The owner reviewed the validation of this version on B200 (sm_100a), GB300 (sm_103a) and VR200 (sm_107a), two runs on each arch, with each autotuned FLA kernel at its first config, where these outputs missed both references, and accepted them capped at their measured values: a value beyond a cap fails, an output judged without FLA's values is not accepted, and every output that is not listed here still fails when it misses both references. tests/cake_naive.py reads this file (accepted_check); the same file is in the family's own tests and in its cross-family tests.

fields.test: pytest node id from tests/experimental/ on
fields.output: the judge's output name (sub-case path and output)
fields.class: the owner's group: 1 out, out_l1, dv, dA_log and dbeta near misses of the single-GPU, saved-set, replay, batched, lean, shared-workspace, two-level carry and hand-off paths; 2 dk and dq of the KCP multi-GPU, shared-workspace and graph-replay paths; 3 none (the dk of the s1450-h2 case of the default-entry KCP tests with the in-kernel Q/K L2 norm, accepted until the fix of the in-kernel L2-norm backward, which removed the class); 4 out, dq, dv and dA_log of the raw-gate slow-decay case [E]; 5 dbeta of the KCP lean, shared-workspace and multi-GPU paths
fields.reference: bf16 or fla: the reference whose rule the output missed in the fewest parts (L2 median, L2 largest, max norm draw by draw) over all its measured misses; on a tie the smaller total shortfall (an L2 ratio's excess over 1.005, relative; the max norm's missing draws over the 16 needed); on an exact tie bf16
fields.l2_median: the largest measured ratio of the output's median L2 error over the draws to the reference's, as the TIER line prints it (nine significant digits)
fields.l2_largest: the same for the largest L2 error over the draws
fields.max_paired: the smallest measured count of draws where the output's max-norm error is within 1.005 x the reference's
fields.draws: the draws of the measured judge
fields.measured: the archs and the number of TIER lines (FAIL met=none) the caps come from
fields.temporary: only on an entry accepted until a fix lands: the miss and the fix that removes the entry; the TIER line of the output shows it
fields.accepted: only on an entry the owner added to the list after the others: the date the owner accepted it
